The '''porkchop''' is a food item with the pack's "classic" porkchop model. It heals {{Hp|4}} the moment it is used, but the pack gives it no recipe, trade or drop: its only source is a loot table for the <code>/loot</code> command. It is a different item from the raw porkchop that pigs drop.

== Obtaining ==
The datapack has a loot table for it, <code>matcha:treasure/porkchop_classic</code>, which no chest, mob or trade uses: <code>/loot give @s loot matcha:treasure/porkchop_classic</code> gives one.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/porkchop_classic.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
The item is a vanilla porkchop with a changed model (<code>matcha:porkchop_classic</code>) and the name "Porkchop". It is consumed at once, with no eating animation or sound, and applies Instant Health when used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/porkchop_classic.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.3|Added a loot table, <code>matcha:treasure/porkchop_classic</code>, to give the item with <code>/loot</code>. The <code>update_item</code> trigger now converts old classic porkchops to the new model.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/item_modifier/porkchop_classic.json}}</ref> The 26.2 release's table already used the 26.3 <code>modifier</code> key, so there it gave a plain raw porkchop.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/porkchop_classic.json|at=d7482cfd1cb9fbd4c633a6d030a954950c70f4d2}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.6-alpha|The loot table gives the classic porkchop, because the pack is for ''Minecraft'' 26.3, which reads the table's <code>modifier</code> key (first in the 1.12.3 alpha for 26.3).}}
{{History line|1.12.8-beta|date=October 23, 2026|The item updater no longer turns a plain raw porkchop held in either hand into this item, as it had since 1.12.6-alpha.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/mainhand/porkchop_classic.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/mainhand/porkchop_classic.json|at=fe225857ed8af507b7f5755f4d41678f6862b1bd}}</ref>}}
}}
